plain_english_policy: Lowering the legal blood-alcohol threshold for drunk driving from 0.10% to 0.08%.

effects.rationale: The policy is enforced by public authorities (law enforcement, courts) and relies on state-mandated standards.
Reduces individual liberty to operate a vehicle under the influence by lowering the threshold for legal impairment.

evidence_quote: Support the lower .08 blood-alcohol-content limit defining drunk driving.
